porting: The stochastic driver is unchanged except its imports and encode wrapper. search_support.py contains the original machine parser, Program.lean parser, layout builder, context-fold opportunity enumeration, matching algorithm, attributes, and grammar serializer.
counter_scope: Sampling attempts, including duplicates and samples with no admissible rotation. Not distinct candidates and not an exhaustive family.
rerun_scope: Wall-clock bounded. Equal seeds do not guarantee equal attempt totals or the same final best result on a different machine or Python version.
cost_scope: Number of distinct new AX reader nodes minus a maximum matching of candidate context folds. Compatibility and literal implementation require separate full verification; only the delivered diagonal198 witness receives that verification here.
